rules.name: xoga713-var-mult-full-parity
rules.sql: SELECT DISTINCT value_date FROM dbsystemuat.curr_mult_table ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:d.value_date[])
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date IN (:d.value_date[])

SELECT c.invenio_product_code, c.value_date, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult, s.settle_value AS fx, c.curr_mult AS stored_curr_mult, CASE WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'multiplication' THEN p.constant_curr_mult * s.settle_value WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'division' THEN p.constant_curr_mult / s.settle_value END AS formula_curr_mult FROM dbsystemuat.curr_mult_table c LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.product_master_table p ON p.invenio_product_code = c.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table s ON s.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor AND s.value_date = c.value_date WHERE c.invenio_product_code IN (:x.invenio_product_code[]) AND c.value_date IN (SELECT value_date FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value_date FROM dbsystemuat.curr_mult_table ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 10) t) ORDER BY c.invenio_product_code, c.value_date
SELECT invenio_product_code FROM opera.var_product_code_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT a.invenio_product_code, count(*) AS accounting_rows, min(a.value_date) AS first_date, max(a.value_date) AS last_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a WHERE a.invenio_product_code IN (:m.invenio_product_code[]) GROUP BY a.invenio_product_code

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor AS master_id, min(s.underlying_id) AS price_id FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN opera.var_product_code_mapping_table v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.invenio_product_code = p.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND lower(s.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.curr_mult_factor IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND x.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor) GROUP BY p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor
